description: One EMA centrally authorised medicine at the latest held generation: every DESIGN.md §2 served field verbatim (name, INN, active substance, therapeutic area (MeSH), ATC code, pharmacotherapeutic group, EMA product number, marketing authorisation holder, opinion adopted date, marketing authorisation issued date, EC decision date, revision number, medicine_status, opinion_status, latest procedure affecting product information and its date, first_published_date, last_updated_date), the generation's source UTC stamp, and the EMA acknowledgement + official-text-prevails lines carried in every payload. Facts only, never advice: no dosage, therapeutic claim, patient-availability judgement, or annex (SmPC / leaflet) text exists in this service; barred shapes are refused free. Structured input only: one identity — {ema_product_number}, {name} (exact, case-insensitive), or {inn} (exact, case-insensitive). Ambiguous identities are refused free with the candidate product numbers listed. Free pre-check at POST /toll/ema/record/preflight (tool ema_record_preflight). Price: $0.01 per call (RULED). — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/ema/record.
name: ema_record
